title: Restore volatile entity counts to auto-generated grounding block
context: A prior commit attempted to drop volatile entity counts (232 decisions, 2 bugs, etc.) from the auto-generated grounding documentation to prevent the counts' frequent changes from causing document staleness. That approach was found to be incorrect. Touches invariant(s): con_8460b6770f (Config/provider writers must merge idempotently into existing user files and refuse to clobber an unparseable file).
decision: Keep volatile entity counts in the auto-generated grounding block. The counts and the Hunch records they describe are committed atomically in the same capture, so the generated documentation cannot go stale — there is no temporal gap between them.
consequences: Entity counts in grounding docs (CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules/, etc.) now reflect the actual Hunch state at each capture
Frequent count changes no longer pose a staleness risk because they arrive in the same commit as the record changes
The grounding block serves as a live inventory of the Hunch graph without requiring separate sync logic
alternatives_rejected: Drop volatile counts from grounding block to minimize document churn (reverted; this commit undoes that choice)
Prevent count changes from triggering grounding doc regeneration (would leave stale counts)
